subject: Re: Pilot credit tranche and usage-safeguard terms
messages:
From: Sarah Patel <sarah@olivetech.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-28T15:12:00Z
Subject: Pilot credits and ramp questions

Hi Ben,

Thanks for the call today — OliveTech is excited to explore a short pilot to validate inference cost and latency for our document processing pipeline. A few things we discussed I wanted captured in writing so we can loop legal:

- We'd like a 60-day pilot with $50k in credits applied to per-token usage.
- If the pilot meets the success metrics (3k qps-equivalent throughput and <200ms P95), we expect to discuss a 12-month commit.
- We want the credit tranche to be released in two parts: 60% up front, 40% after milestone sign-off.

Can you confirm Redwood's position on:
1) whether the credit tranche can be conditional on milestone acceptance;
2) whether you require a minimum monthly usage floor during the first 3 months post-pilot;
3) how per-token volume discounts would tier against a committed monthly spend (we're interested in a per-token ladder rather than a flat percent).

I've attached our SOW template for reference (OliveTech_SOW_template.docx). Looping in our legal: legal@olivetech.com for contract items.

Appreciate it —
Sarah
VP, Product
OliveTech
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Patel <sarah@olivetech.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-29T10:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Pilot credits and ramp questions

Thanks Sarah — great to speak. High level response below and I attached a draft term sheet for the pilot (pilot-term-sheet-v1.pdf).

1) Conditional tranche: Yes. We can split the $50k credit into 60/40 tied to an objective milestone (integration + baseline run for 60%; post-milestone performance sign-off for 40%). We typically document the milestone acceptance criteria in the SOW.

2) Usage floor: We recommend a soft usage floor for the first 3 months after conversion to ensure predictable economics — e.g., a minimum of 30% of committed monthly tokens as a ramp floor. If the floor isn't met, we implement a prorated clawback against remaining credits (not an invoice). Open to discussing the exact % with your finance team.

3) Per-token ladder: We can do tiered per-token pricing tied to committed monthly throughput. Example ladder in attached sheet: 0-10M tokens = $0.0008/token, 10-50M = $0.00065/token, 50M+ = $0.0005/token. The ladder is applied to committed spend; overages billed at on-demand rates but eligible for retroactive credit if overage persists and we convert to a higher committed tier.

Next steps: if this aligns, I can fold Laura in (she leads commercial approvals) to sign off and produce pilot paperwork.

Best,
Ben
Account Exec, Redwood Inference

—Ben

Thanks for the context. Agree with the 60/40 tranche structure, but suggest these changes before sending to customer:

- Ramp floor: set to 35% for the first 3 months post-conversion to reduce churn risk.
- Clawback: make it a credit adjustment (we apply a clawback against remaining credits) rather than billing cash back — easier operationally and less friction.
- Milestone definition: require performance verification run on a 2-day baseline dataset (we own the test harness or accept their harness if mutually agreed).
- Limit upfront exposure: cap the up-front credit at $35k (so total remains $50k, 35k up-front / 15k on sign-off).

Marissa — can you update the term sheet to reflect the cap and the 35% floor? Once updated I will sign off and Ben can return to Sarah.

Laura
Head of Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Patel <sarah@olivetech.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-01T14:42:00Z
Subject: Re: Pilot credits and ramp questions — updated term sheet attached

Sarah — appreciate the patience. Attached is an updated term sheet (pilot-term-sheet-v2.pdf) and a compact pricing matrix (pricing_matrix.csv) that reflects the changes Laura approved:

- $50k pilot credits split 70% up-front / 30% on milestone sign-off (we adjusted split to keep alignment with your request while limiting exposure).
- Up-front cap: $35,000 (we only front $35k, remaining $15k released post-sign-off).
- Ramp floor: customer agrees to a minimum usage equal to 35% of the committed monthly token volume for the first 3 months post-conversion; failure triggers a credit adjustment (no cash invoice).
- Per-token ladder: included in pricing_matrix.csv; on-demand overage rates and retroactive eligibility on sustained overages are called out.

Please review and confirm if OliveTech legal needs any additional clauses (I copied your legal contact). If you confirm, we can prepare a short SOW addendum and aim to kick off integration next week.

Attachments: pilot-term-sheet-v2.pdf, pricing_matrix.csv

Best regards,
Ben
Account Exec, Redwood Inference

Ben — thanks for the update and for incorporating the changes quickly. OliveTech is broadly comfortable with the structure but legal asked for two small additions before we sign:

1) A short mutual NDA clause for pilot data usage (we need to be sure test documents are not used beyond evaluation).
2) Simple acceptance language that defines sign-off as a shared, written confirmation (email OK) within 5 business days of the performance verification run.

If Redwood can add those, we're happy to proceed and book the kickoff for Nov 9.

Thanks —
Sarah
